label: Macau: its current land
why: Natural Earth's Macau predates the reclamations, so NAPE, east Taipa and Cotai (about 12 km2) were in Zhuhai's zone. world_plan.NE_REPLACE takes OSM's Macau relation's land (35 km2) as Macau's unit and cuts it out of China's units, so mcu is rebuilt after zhu (the Guangdong spec rebuilds zhu).
